tests.name: cbor_large_vector_output
tests.intent: Verify that generating CBOR binary output for a large array of numbers (exceeding the window size) produces valid output bytes correctly.

tests.name: msgpack_large_vector_output
tests.intent: Verify that generating MessagePack output for a large array of numbers works correctly and returns non-empty byte vector.

tests.name: ubjson_large_vector_output
tests.intent: Verify that UBJSON output generation for a large structure behaves properly and produces valid size.

tests.name: bjdata_large_vector_output
tests.intent: Verify that BJData serialization of a large numeric array completes correctly.

tests.name: bson_large_vector_output
tests.intent: Verify that BSON serialization of a large object containing many fields functions properly.

tests.name: cbor_empty_vector_output
tests.intent: Verify CBOR output for an empty JSON structure to ensure minimum sink capacities are respected.

tests.name: msgpack_empty_vector_output
tests.intent: Verify MessagePack output for an empty JSON array handles minimal boundary conditions.

tests.name: ubjson_empty_vector_output
tests.intent: Verify UBJSON output for null values respects the initial sink allocation window.

tests.name: bjdata_empty_vector_output
tests.intent: Verify BJData output for a boolean value handles minimal sink requirements.

tests.name: bson_empty_vector_output
tests.intent: Verify BSON output for an empty object handles minimal sink buffers correctly.

tests.name: cbor_nested_structures
tests.intent: Verify CBOR output on deeply nested objects to trigger multiple window growths and reallocations.

tests.name: msgpack_nested_structures
tests.intent: Verify MessagePack output on deeply nested structures handling output sink windows correctly.

tests.name: ubjson_nested_structures
tests.intent: Verify UBJSON output on deeply nested arrays ensuring correct windowed buffer growth.

tests.name: bjdata_nested_structures
tests.intent: Verify BJData serialization on deeply nested arrays exercising sink allocation windowing.

tests.name: bson_nested_structures
tests.intent: Verify BSON serialization on deeply nested objects testing sink memory management.

tests.name: cbor_string_heavy
tests.intent: Verify CBOR output on a collection of long strings exercising continuous window growths.

tests.name: msgpack_string_heavy
tests.intent: Verify MessagePack output on a collection of long strings to confirm correct sink writing.

tests.name: ubjson_string_heavy
tests.intent: Verify UBJSON output on long strings checking buffer window reallocation behavior.

tests.name: bjdata_string_heavy
tests.intent: Verify BJData output on long strings checking correct sizing and window updates.

tests.name: bson_string_heavy
tests.intent: Verify BSON output on long strings checking correct serialization and vector trimming.
